content:
The AI for Math team at BICMR@PKU gladly presents jixia (GitHub), a next-generation tool for extracting declaration info, dependency graph, tactic execution states, etc., as structured data.

You do not need to modify your project to use it; it takes advantage of an already built project. This means you don't have to rebuild the entire mathlib4 to extract useful info from it; instead, simply run lake exe cache get then run jixia on it.

It also features a modular design which means you can easily implement new plugins in this framework.

We hope this little tool can be helpful in understanding the structure of a Lean project, in visualizing the relations between theorems, or in aiding the training of Lean-aware ATP agents.

We are building more infrastructures for Lean, mainly focusing on metaprogramming and handling structured data. Stay tuned!
